name: ButtonGroup
purpose: Lay out a set of related, independent action buttons with consistent spacing and direction.
intent: Centralize the recurring 'N buttons, one gap, one direction' layout without introducing any new visual treatment - all color/radius/typography comes from the Button/IconButton children.

figmaLayoutData.childInstanceExample: Each child is a real button-atom instance (size=sm, tone=primary), independently rounded (8px corner radius) - no shared/joined border between buttons.

apiAdaptationNotes: Figma's `count` (2/3/4) variant axis is not a real prop - it only demonstrates the pattern with different numbers of example buttons. The component accepts any number of children.
Figma's `inline`/`stacked` orientation values were renamed to `horizontal`/`vertical` to match this system's existing RadioGroup.orientation vocabulary.
aria-label/aria-labelledby are exposed via native React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, not a bespoke ariaLabel prop, matching the Button/IconButton family's convention.

anatomy.description: Flex layout container that spaces and directs its children; owns no button styling.
Typically Button and/or IconButton elements, laid out with a consistent 8px gap.

children.description: The buttons (or other controls) to lay out.

requirements: Do not add roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation - children keep native Tab order.
Do not add a role without an accompanying accessible name.
Ensure each child button remains independently focusable.

behaviorRules: Do not restyle or override child button appearance.
Apply data-orientation equal to the selected orientation.
Add role=group only when aria-label or aria-labelledby is provided.
Forward all other native div attributes via rest props.
compositionRules: Button Group may wrap Button and/or IconButton elements.
Use a selection-oriented pattern instead of Button Group for mutually exclusive choices.
Do not use Button Group merely to visually join/connect buttons into one shape.
contentRules: No text content owned by Button Group itself.
themeRules: Must work in light and dark themes - inherited entirely from the Button/IconButton children, since Button Group owns no color tokens.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo + React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement> for the exported component.
No hardcoded spacing - gap comes from --spacing-sm.
align-items: flex-start on the root, matching Figma's MIN counter-axis alignment, so children keep their own width/height instead of stretching to match a sibling.
do: Use for a toolbar or action row of related, independent buttons.
Set size/appearance/tone directly on each child Button.
Add aria-label when the group's purpose isn't obvious from context.
dont: Do not use for exclusive/segmented selection.
Do not use for a single button.
Do not expect Button Group to restyle or join its children.
acceptanceCriteria: Applies data-orientation for the selected orientation.
No role when unlabeled; role=group when aria-label/aria-labelledby is present.
Forwards native div attributes (className, data-*, etc.) via rest props.
Uses --spacing-sm for the gap between children in both orientations.
Storybook includes Playground, Variants, and Composition.
Tests cover children ordering, orientation, aria/role behavior, and native attribute forwarding.
knownLimitations: No fullWidth/stretched-children variant (Figma source has none).
Does not validate that children are Button/IconButton instances.
futureEnhancements: A fullWidth-style stretched variant if Figma adds one
